reason: Checked budget_measures.carers_allowance_earnings_taper: from 2030-31 it replaces carers_allowance_pre_overlap for carers whose weekly net earnings are above the Weekly Earnings Limit, 16 hours at the OBR's National Living Wage for that April, rounded up to the pound (£212 at April 2027's £13.21), not the engine's earnings limit, with the weekly rate less £1 for each £1 of earnings above the limit, floored at zero. 2030-31 counts half of the year's change (first_year_share=0.5). At or below the limit, before 2030-31, in Scotland (Carer Support Payment) and in Northern Ireland the native amount stands, and it adds no take-up draw of its own. The receipt's outputs were compared with the hand-computed cases in tests/test_carers_allowance_earnings_taper.py.
